overview: The gated neighbourhood combines apartments, duplex townhouses, twin villas and standalone homes.
Original documents carry Q Properties branding. Q Holding acquired Modon Properties in February 2024 and adopted the Modon Holding name in March; Reem Hills now appears in Modon’s portfolio.
research.locationNote: Reem Hills, Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi; confirm the selected building and cluster.
research.priceNote: The project FAQ advertises one-bedroom apartments from AED 1.5 million. The separate island listing shows AED 4.1 million; neither establishes a current quotation for every phase.
research.paymentNote: Modon advertises 50/50 without a dated instalment calendar. The table is Property Finder’s villa reference; its apartment listing instead gives 10/30/60. Confirm release-specific terms.
research.handoverNote: The project FAQ estimates villas for Q2 2026 and apartments for Q2 2027; the island listing gives Q1 2029. Property Finder labels villas ready and apartments December 2026. Completion and the applicable phase remain unverified.
